(RS_AP_00130)
The overloads of
std::get
are contained in the
ara::core
namespace; they can
either be called explicitly (i.e. namespace-qualified), or be invoked via ADL.
For ADL lookup to work in C++14,
get
needs to be called without namespace qualifi-
cation, similar to the way that
swap
is recommended to be called, e.g.:
1
using std::get;
2
3
ara::core::Array<int, 4> array = {1, 2, 3, 4};
4
int& e = get<0>(array);
